verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage markets an in-product Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent that auto-remediates level 1 alerts and escalates high-risk or complex cases to human reviewers, so the core in-product agent review exists. Nothing shows the agent recording a rationale for its decisions; the case audit-trail endpoint is generic and is not tied to agent reasoning. Missing for 10: documented recording of the agent's rationale per match, in-depth first-party docs on how the agent reviews matches, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to review screening matches with recorded rationale
